tests.title: Cushion compression

scene.description: A soft cushion compressed between a fixed base and a loaded top plate. PROPOSED: Person B confirms the real scene and protocol at the feasibility gate.
scene.source: PowerSim released assets (nttung1110/PowerSim); attribution to the original authors.

metric.label: Peak compression
metric.definition: 100 x (initial - current) separation of the upper and lower particle-group centroids along the loading axis, divided by the initial separation. Groups are fixed at the unloaded state.
metric.window_description: Peak over the full simulated interval (0-2.0 simulation s), identical for every candidate.

unit_system.load: multiplier of the scene reference load
unit_system.notes: Physical scale and force interpretation of the released scene have not been established.

assumptions: Every candidate uses the same geometry, density, Poisson's ratio, supports, load protocol, camera, duration and numerical settings; only stiffness differs.
Stiffness is a multiplier of the released scene's baseline. Flexible, Balanced and Firm are parameter scenarios, not verified commercial material grades.
Load is a dimensionless multiplier of the scene's reference load; no force in newtons is implied.
Deformation is reported as a percentage of the unloaded reference separation along the loading axis.
Geometry-based compression is a screening metric only; transmitted force, energy absorption, recovery and repeated loading are not modelled.
